description: Begin your adventure in a dangerous world full of powerful monsters, rare resources, and hidden treasures.
body:
# Start your adventure on Zoned!
Begin your adventure in a dangerous world full of powerful monsters, rare resources, and hidden treasures. Explore unique zones, defeat challenging enemies, and gather valuable materials to grow stronger every day. Use what you collect to craft, build, and upgrade your empire. Choose your own path, focus on combat, exploration, or building, and conquer Zoned your way, alone or with friends.

Join our discord today! [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/zonedrip)
